title: GET /items/:id returns one item or 404
intent: Clients need to fetch a single item by id. Return the item as JSON with 200 when it exists, and { "error": "not found" } with 404 when it does not. A non-integer id is also a 404.

title: POST /items enforces a name length limit
intent: Names longer than 64 characters are rejected with 400 and { "error": "name too long" }. Names of exactly 64 characters are accepted. The existing missing-name 400 behavior is unchanged.

title: GET /health reports uptime seconds
intent: Operators want to know how long the process has been up. GET /health returns { "status": "ok", "uptime_seconds": <integer >= 0> } computed from process start. The status field is unchanged.

title: DELETE /items/:id requires an admin bearer token
intent: Operators need to remove items. DELETE /items/:id deletes the item and returns 204. The route is protected: the request must carry Authorization: Bearer <token> where <token> equals process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN; a missing or wrong token returns 401 { "error": "unauthorized" } and deletes nothing. When ADMIN_TOKEN is unset the route always returns 401. An unknown or non-integer id with a valid token returns 404 { "error": "not found" }. No other route changes.
